In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/console-operator/pull/1188):

>## Summary
>
>During upgrades, the console operator re-applies the console deployment with updated configmap/secret resource-version annotations. Each update bumps `Generation`, and for a sub-second window `ObservedGeneration` lags behind. The generation check (introduced by [PR #1169](https://github.com/openshift/console-operator/pull/1169) for [OCPBUGS-64688](https://issues.redhat.com/browse/OCPBUGS-64688)) sees this gap and reports `Progressing=True`.
>
>These blips coincide with MCO's `Progressing=True` window, failing the OTA invariant test (`clusteroperator/console should stay Progressing=False while MCO is Progressing=True`) in ~5% of upgrade jobs.
>
>The previous fix ([PR #1178](https://github.com/openshift/console-operator/pull/1178)) used a blanket `changed` flag to skip the generation check after any deployment update. This suppressed the MCO-window blips but also suppressed genuine upgrade progress reporting, breaking a second invariant test ([TRT-2780](https://issues.redhat.com/browse/TRT-2780): console must report `Progressing=True` during its own upgrade). PR #1178 was [reverted](https://github.com/openshift/console-operator/pull/1186).
>
>## Changes
>
>Two changes, following the 3CMO pattern from [cluster-cloud-controller-manager-operator#488](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-cloud-controller-manager-operator/pull/488):
>
>- **Version-gated check**: Only run the deployment progress check during version transitions (`co.versionGetter.GetVersions()["operator"] != version`). Outside upgrades, skip entirely — annotation-driven spec updates during the MCO window cannot produce blips.
>
>- **Rollout status instead of generation gap**: Replace `checkDeploymentGenerationProgress` with `checkDeploymentRolloutStatus`, which checks the deployment controller's own `Progressing` condition (`NewReplicaSetAvailable` = complete, `ProgressDeadlineExceeded` = stalled) rather than just the sub-second generation gap.
>
>
>## Tests
>
>- [ ] New unit tests: `TestCheckDeploymentRolloutStatus` — 8 cases covering rollout complete, generation gap, in-progress (ReplicaSetUpdated, NewReplicaSetCreated), stalled (ProgressDeadlineExceeded), no condition, observed > generation, initial rollout
>- [ ] `make test-unit` passes (all packages, gofmt, govet)
>- [ ] CI e2e: verify no `SyncLoopRefreshProgressing` blips during upgrade window
>
>Assisted by: Claude (Opus 4.6)

If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>

Rollout success, stalled progress, and unavailable states are handled by a new helper, with tests updated to validate condition-based outcomes. ### Changes **Deployment rollout validation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Rollout status gating**
`pkg/console/operator/sync_v400.go`|The upgrade flow calls `checkDeploymentRolloutStatus`, which evaluates observed generation and `DeploymentProgressing` conditions for success, stalled rollout, or in-progress states.| |**Rollout status test coverage**
`pkg/console/operator/sync_v400_test.go`|Tests now provide deployment conditions and assert rollout errors using substring matching.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Suggested reviewers:** `jhadvig`, `therealjon`, `logonoff`, `leo6leo`, `devguyio`

Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | No Ginkgo titles were added; the new test uses static t.Run names, with no dynamic values or generated identifiers. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | PASS: This is a table-driven unit test, not Ginkgo; each case targets one rollout behavior, with no cluster setup/waits and explicit error messages. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo e2e tests were added; the change is a unit test using only Deployment status fields. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo/e2e tests were added; the changed file contains only Go unit tests and no SNO-sensitive multi-node assumptions. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only rollout-status logic and tests changed;
